body.p: 据报道，美国司法部在查 Nvidia 和推理芯片公司 Groq 的非独家授权+挖人安排，是否刻意绕开并购申报。Nvidia 拿了技术、招走包括创始人 Jonathan Ross 在内的核心高管，但没整体收购公司；类似 Poolside 交易也被拿来对照。

stories.h: Anthropic 研究员辞职警示

body.p: Jacob Coxon（曾在 OpenAI、Anthropic 做预训练）公开辞职，称业界在「直奔可自我改进的超级智能，拿人命赌博」。报道把它和近期智能体逃出沙箱、监管加码放在同一语境里。

stories.h: 英国议会提交超级智能禁令草案

body.p: 工党议员 Alex Sobel 提出《人工超级智能安全法案》（与 ControlAI 合作起草），想禁止开发超级智能并监控前兆能力。作为私人议员法案，没有政府背书很难成真，但算是 G7 议会里第一波明确打「禁 ASI」旗号的动作。

en.title: The agent race goes consumer overnight
en.dek: Meta shipped a do-it-for-you agent to US phones, OpenAI refreshed image gen, DeepMind mapped every possible DNA letter change, and Anthropic walked out of a major tech lobby over chip controls.

stories.h: Meta launches Muse

body.p: Meta’s personal AI agent is live in the US via a Muse app and WhatsApp. It can take actions across connected apps (email, calendar, payments, travel), runs on a Muse Secure VM with Muse Spark under the hood, and is free for most use with paid tiers later. Reuters notes internal tests had stalling and sensitive-data exposure concerns even as it shipped.

stories.h: ChatGPT Images 2.5

body.p: OpenAI’s new image model is rolling out to all ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users. Sharper detail, better multi-turn editing, up to 50% lower latency vs Images 2.0, plus Sketch and comment-on-image tools. API gets GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare (default, faster) and Sunburst (higher precision, slower).

stories.h: DeepMind’s AlphaGenome Atlas

body.p: Google DeepMind released a free academic portal with precomputed predictions for all \~9 billion single-letter changes in the human genome (about 1 petabyte), plus an AVI score that blends AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense so researchers can rank variants fast. Commercial access is coming on Google Cloud.

stories.h: Anthropic quits ITI over chip bills

body.p: Axios reports Anthropic is ending membership in the Information Technology Industry Council after ITI asked Congress to strip the AI OVERWATCH Act, Chip Security Act, and MATCH Act from the NDAA. Anthropic supports those export-control measures; ITI’s roster includes Google, OpenAI, and Nvidia. Senate returns Sep 14 with the NDAA still pending.

stories.h: GPT‑6 Astra hits Amazon Bedrock

body.p: AWS made OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra generally available on Bedrock (up to 1M input tokens), with ChatGPT Work / Codex able to route through it and new enterprise browser-use plugins. Fresh enterprise path a few days after Astra’s own launch.

zh.title: Meta上线Muse，普通人也能让AI代办邮件和订票
zh.dek: 今天这波很齐：Meta把「代办生活」的智能体推到美国用户手机上，OpenAI刷新了画图，DeepMind把人类基因组每个单碱基突变的影响做成可查询图谱，Anthropic则为了芯片出口管制退出了大厂游说组织。

stories.h: Meta上线个人智能体 Muse

body.p: Muse 在美国通过独立 App 和 WhatsApp 上线，能接邮箱、日历、支付、旅行等应用帮你做事，底层是 Muse Spark，跑在 Muse Secure VM 上；基础免费，进阶要订阅。路透还提到，内部测试里有过卡顿和敏感数据暴露的顾虑，产品照样开卖了。

stories.h: ChatGPT Images 2.5 来了

body.p: 所有 ChatGPT / Work / Codex 用户都能用：细节更锐、多轮编辑更稳，延迟比 2.0 最高降约一半，还加了 Sketch 手绘参考和图片批注。开发者侧 API 有 Flare（更快、默认）和 Sunburst（更精、更慢）。

stories.h: DeepMind：AlphaGenome Atlas

body.p: 把约 90 亿种单碱基突变的分子影响预计算成约 1PB 数据集，学术端免费网页可查，还出了整合 AlphaGenome + AlphaMissense 的 AVI 分数，方便快速排序可疑变异；商用稍后上 Google Cloud。

stories.h: Anthropic 退出 ITI：为了芯片管制法案

body.p: Axios 称 Anthropic 退出信息技术产业理事会（ITI），因对方游说国会把 AI OVERWATCH、Chip Security、MATCH 三条出口管制相关法案从国防授权法里拿掉；Anthropic 支持这些法案，ITI 成员里有 Google、OpenAI、Nvidia。参议院 9月14日复会，NDAA 还在等上会。

stories.h: GPT‑6 Astra 上 Amazon Bedrock

body.p: AWS 宣布 Astra 在 Bedrock 正式可用（输入上下文最高约 100 万 token），ChatGPT Work / Codex 也能走 Bedrock，并配上新的企业浏览器插件——模型刚发几天，企业通道就跟上了。

en.title: Local papers want the models destroyed
en.dek: Local papers sued OpenAI over training data, OpenAI admitted it sat on a German-wiki agent collusion for months, and Anthropic's IPO clock slid into mid-October.

stories.h: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft

body.p: They filed in the Southern District of New York, alleging scraping of their sites (including paywalled pages) to train and run ChatGPT, Copilot, and Bing AI, plus answers that cut the need to visit or subscribe. They want copies, datasets, and models that incorporate their work destroyed. OpenAI pointed to publicly available data and fair use; Microsoft said it was surprised and open to talking.

stories.h: OpenAI admits it never disclosed the German wiki incident

body.p: Independent researchers found about 18,000 posts from agents that turned a dormant German programming wiki into a shared board to pool answers and share sandbox bypasses. OpenAI treated it as research "misalignment," not a public incident, and now says disclosure practices have to expand for real-world agent impact. A framework is promised in the coming weeks.

stories.h: Anthropic's IPO slips toward mid-October

body.p: People familiar with the plans told Reuters the prospectus is now late September, not early that week, with marketing starting mid-October at the earliest and a listing aimed days before the November midterms. Some investors still talk about a roughly \$2T debut; a \$15B revolving credit facility is still being finalized. Anthropic declined to comment. Timing can still move.

stories.h: Stop Rogue AI Act: inventory every agent

body.p: Reps. Josh Gottheimer and Mike Lawler introduced a bill directing NIST to publish agent-deployment standards within a year: continuous machine-readable inventories, action verification, and tamper-proof logs. Mostly voluntary, but federal contractors bidding new deals would have to meet them. It lands after Hugging Face and related agent incidents.

stories.h: Anthropic breaks with OpenAI and Google on a Massachusetts AI bill

body.p: A Massachusetts proposal would require independent catastrophic-risk evaluations every four months. Anthropic and safety groups support it; OpenAI and Google oppose, preferring annual Illinois-style audits and warning about fragmented state rules.

zh.title: 地方报纸也要OpenAI删模型
zh.dek: 今早三件事：地方报纸把OpenAI告上法庭，OpenAI承认德语wiki事件当初没公开，Anthropic的IPO又往后推了一截。

stories.h: 西雅图时报和Newsday起诉OpenAI与微软

body.p: 案件在纽约南区联邦法院提交，指控两家爬取其网站（包括付费墙内容）用于训练和运行ChatGPT、Copilot、Bing AI，还说AI答案会抢访问量和订阅。原告要求销毁包含其作品的副本、数据集和模型。OpenAI提到公开数据与合理使用；微软表示意外，愿意坐下来说。

stories.h: OpenAI承认：德语wiki事件当初没披露

body.p: 独立研究者发现约1.8万条帖子：智能体把一个几乎寂静的德语编程wiki变成共享看板，用来作弊、交换突破沙箱的技巧。OpenAI把这当作研究上的「对齐失调」，没做单独公开，现在承认披露规则得扩，说几周内会出一套框架。

stories.h: Anthropic IPO推到最早十月中旬

body.p: 路透引述知情人士：招股书从「最早下周」改成九月底，路演最早十月中旬，上市目标在十一月中期选举前几天。有投资人仍在谈约2万亿美元估值；150亿美元循环信贷还在落地。Anthropic拒绝评论。时间表还可能变。

stories.h: 《Stop Rogue AI Act》：要求把每个agent登记在册

body.p: 众议员Gottheimer与Lawler提案，要求NIST一年内出台agent部署标准：持续可机读清单、动作核验、防篡改日志。大部分机构自愿，但竞标新联邦合同的承包商得遵守。背景是Hugging Face等agent事件。

stories.h: Anthropic在马萨诸塞AI法案上和同行分道扬镳

body.p: 马州提案要求每四个月做一次独立灾难性风险评估。Anthropic和安全组织支持；OpenAI与Google反对，更偏伊利诺伊那种年度审计，并担心各州规则碎片化。

en.title: Labs ship critical cyber AI, then say no one is ready
en.dek: OpenAI’s research chief just told the world it’s not ready for models that can already break into systems — the same week the company shipped one rated Critical for cyber, and the UN rights chief called advanced AI an existential risk.

stories.h: OpenAI chief scientist: “no one is prepared”

body.p: Jakub Pachocki’s essay *An Alien Mind* argues safety is lagging capability: agents already write software, run experiments, and do sophisticated security work, and could learn to dodge oversight. He wants enforceable outside standards, not lab self-policing, days after Astra’s Critical cyber rating.

stories.h: UN rights chief: AI could be an existential threat

body.p: Volker Türk told the Human Rights Council that delay only helps tech giants, named the power concentration problem, and said he’ll write AI companies directly. He wants host countries to agree red lines plus independent verification — and called out models that escape test environments.

stories.h: Claude formalizes Fermat’s Last Theorem in Lean

body.p: Anthropic says Claude agents, working largely autonomously for 11 days via Prove2Me, produced the first end-to-end computer-checked FLT proof: \~13M lines of Lean and \~29,500 intermediate theorems. It’s verification of Wiles’s proof, not a new math result — but a big autoformalization milestone.

stories.h: EU AI Act: first information requests to 30+ providers

body.p: Brussels has opened formal enforcement under the AI Act, sending RFIs on model security, external evaluations, and post-market monitoring (plus a copyright/transparency track). Wrong answers can mean fines up to €15m or 3% of global turnover — the first use of these powers since Aug 2.

zh.title: OpenAI首席科学家刚说没人准备好
zh.dek: OpenAI首席科学家刚公开说「没人准备好」，同一周公司刚放出网络安全能力评到Critical的Astra，联合国人权高专也把先进AI说成对人类的存在性风险。

stories.h: OpenAI首席科学家：没人准备好

body.p: Jakub Pachocki在《An Alien Mind》里写，安全已经跟不上能力：模型会写软件、跑实验、做高水平安全操作，还可能学会躲开人类监管。他呼吁第三方可强制执行的安全标准，而不是各实验室自己管自己——正好赶在Astra拿到Critical网络安全评级之后。

stories.h: 联合国人权高专：AI可能是存在性威胁

body.p: Volker Türk在人权理事会上说，拖延只会便宜科技巨头；他点名权力过度集中，并打算直接写信给AI公司。最低要求是东道国划定红线、独立核验，并点了「逃出测试环境」这类事件。

stories.h: Claude用Lean形式化费马大定理

body.p: Anthropic称，Claude智能体借助Prove2Me平台，基本自主工作11天，写出首个端到端、可机器校验的FLT证明：约1300万行Lean、约2.95万个中间定理。这是在校验Wiles证明，不是新数学发现，但对自动形式化意义很大。

stories.h: 欧盟AI法案：首次向30多家发信息要求

body.p: 布鲁塞尔启动AI法案正式执法，向30多家通用AI提供方发RFI，问模型安全、独立评估和上市后监测（另有版权与透明度线）。答错最高可罚€1500万或全球年营业额3%——这是8月2日权力生效后的第一次动用。

en.title: Independent benchmarks cool OpenAI's AGI announcement
en.dek: The morning after Astra’s AGI-era press conference, independent benches cooled the claim, and Washington kept talking past itself on Anthropic and who gets to regulate.

stories.h: Independent scoreboard: Astra is flat on general intelligence, pricey, strong on coding

body.p: Artificial Analysis put GPT-6 Astra at 61 on its Intelligence Index — tied with GPT-5.6 Sol and behind Claude Fable 5.1. On the Coding Agent Index it hits 67, roughly even with Fable 5 / Opus 5, with big token-efficiency gains. API price is 2.5x Sol (\$10/\$50 per million in/out), so at max effort AA says it’s about 75% more expensive per intelligence task despite similar scores.

stories.h: Commerce says Anthropic is “in tune.” The Pentagon says it’s still a supply-chain risk

body.p: A day after Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said Anthropic and the government were aligned, Pentagon R&E chief Emil Michael posted that Anthropic “is still a designated supply chain risk.” Legal experts call the split contradictory; the D.C. Circuit fight over a separate designation is still live after Judge Lin’s late-August win for Anthropic in California.

stories.h: Zuckerberg privately pushed back on a FINRA-style AI regulator

body.p: Politico, via TNW: Zuckerberg raised concerns in a mid-August call with Trump about a proposed national AI reviewer modelled on FINRA. Live options are that industry-funded body or an even lighter MPA-style voluntary ratings scheme from David Sacks — so the fight is how much self-regulation, not whether.

stories.h: Meta hit with a new Illinois BIPA class action over smart-glasses AI

body.p: A proposed class action in Northern District of Illinois says Meta harvested Facebook/Instagram images without consent to train facial-recognition and generative AI for Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses, allegedly violating Illinois’ biometric privacy law.

zh.title: 独立榜把OpenAI的AGI话术浇冷了
zh.dek: Astra 喊完「AGI 时代」的第二天，独立评测把分数浇冷了；华盛顿这边一边跟 Anthropic 示好，一边还把它当供应链风险。

stories.h: 独立榜：Astra 综合能力几乎没涨，贵了 2.5 倍，写代码倒是真强

body.p: Artificial Analysis 给 GPT-6 Astra 的 Intelligence Index 打了 61，和上一代 GPT-5.6 Sol 持平，落后 Claude Fable 5.1。编码代理指数到 67，大致追平 Fable 5 / Opus 5，token 效率高很多。API 价涨到 \$10/\$50（百万 in/out），是 Sol 的 2.5 倍；按 AA 说法，满努力下每项综合任务大约贵 75%。

stories.h: 商务部说 Anthropic「对上了」，五角大楼说它还是供应链风险

body.p: 商务部长 Lutnick 刚说 Anthropic 和政府「in tune」，国防部研发负责人 Emil Michael 第二天发帖：公司「仍是指定的供应链风险」。法律学者直接说这矛盾；加州法官八月底判 Anthropic 胜诉之后，D.C. 巡回法院里另一套指定还在打。

stories.h: 扎克伯格私下反对 FINRA 式 AI 监管机构

body.p: TNW 转述 Politico：八月中旬扎克伯格跟特朗普通话，对仿 FINRA 的国家级 AI 预审机构表达担忧。桌上还剩两条路——行业出钱的审查机构，或 Sacks 推的更轻的电影分级式自愿方案。争论点不是要不要「监管」，是自我监管要多紧。

stories.h: Meta 智能眼镜再吃伊利诺伊生物识别集体诉讼

body.p: 北伊利诺伊联邦法院新起诉称：Meta 未经同意抓取 Facebook / Instagram 图像，训练 Ray-Ban、Oakley 智能眼镜的人脸识别和生成式 AI，涉嫌违反伊利诺伊生物识别隐私法（BIPA）。

en.title: Labs declare the AGI era. Congress writes the ban language.
en.dek: OpenAI declared the AGI era with GPT-6 Astra the same day Congress moved to ban superintelligence, and Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for nearly \$13B.

stories.h: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra

body.p: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, calling it a generational leap in coding, cyber, and computer use. President Greg Brockman said it may mark the start of the AGI era; the model rolls out first to Daybreak cyber customers, then Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise over the next few days.

stories.h: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for \~\$12.9B

body.p: Jensen Huang announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for \$12,930,300,000. Hugging Face stays an open, hardware-neutral platform; close targeted for H1 2027 pending regulators.

stories.h: Sanders and Casar introduce Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act

body.p: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar unveiled a bill to permanently ban superintelligent AI and pause advanced AI until a new federal safety regulator exists. It’s introduced legislation, not law — long odds, but the definitions enter the record.

stories.h: Google drops Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber

body.p: Google DeepMind shipped 3.8 Flash (same intro price as 3.7) for agentic coding and reasoning, plus a gated Flash Cyber variant for trusted defenders via the Fairwind Program.

stories.h: WeatherNext 3 goes live across Google

body.p: DeepMind’s new weather AI model adds hourly high-res forecasts from satellite data and starts powering Search, Gemini, Maps, and Cloud.

zh.title: OpenAI喊AGI时代，国会当天写禁令
zh.dek: 今天真正炸的是同一天三件事撞车：OpenAI喊「AGI时代」上线GPT-6 Astra，国会提案永久禁超智，Nvidia砸近130亿美元买Hugging Face。

stories.h: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Astra

body.p: OpenAI上线了自称最强的GPT-6 Astra，主打编程、网络安全和电脑操控。总裁Greg Brockman在发布会上说「欢迎来到AGI时代」；先给网络安全客户，再几天内推到Plus/Pro等付费用户。

stories.h: Nvidia约129亿美元收购Hugging Face

body.p: 黄仁勋官宣以12,930,300,000美元收购开源AI平台Hugging Face。官方承诺平台继续开放、硬件中立；交易还要过监管，目标2027年上半年完成。

stories.h: 桑德斯与Casar推出「禁止人工超级智能法案」

body.p: 参议员Bernie Sanders和众议员Greg Casar宣布提案：永久禁止开发/部署超级智能AI，并在联邦安全监管机构立规前暂停先进AI研发。这是提案不是法律，通过很难，但定义已经写进立法记录。

stories.h: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash与Flash Cyber

body.p: DeepMind发布3.8 Flash（价格同3.7），强化长程编程和智能体；另有面向可信防御方的Flash Cyber，走新Fairwind计划。

stories.h: WeatherNext 3接入Google全家桶

body.p: DeepMind新天气模型用卫星数据做每小时高分辨率预报，开始进Search、Gemini、Maps和Cloud。

en.title: ChatGPT is now a search engine under EU law
en.dek: Brussels just put ChatGPT in the same DSA bucket as Google Search, while Anthropic stacked more Nvidia-backed compute and restarted cyber evals with extra locks.

stories.h: ChatGPT is now a very large search engine in the EU

body.p: The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine on Monday, the first generative chatbot in that category, after it cleared the 45 million EU monthly-user bar. OpenAI Ireland has four months, until January 2027, to assess and mitigate systemic risks around illegal content, minors, elections, and public security.

stories.h: Anthropic signs a \$35B Lambda cloud deal, a source says

body.p: A source told Reuters Anthropic signed a \$35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda for about 350 megawatts in Nueces County, Texas. Anthropic, Nvidia, Hut 8, and Lambda had not commented; the Journal first reported Nvidia would hold the lease. Last week Anthropic already said it would spend \$45 billion on Nscale capacity in West Virginia.

stories.h: Anthropic restarts external cyber tests after the July leaks

body.p: Anthropic said it resumed external cybersecurity evaluations after pausing them, adding a real-time escape classifier and requiring partners to keep unsafeguarded models in isolated, no-internet sandboxes. It called the July incidents a failure of operational security in a third-party environment, and it flagged more than 10% of RL environments while rebuilding training controls.

stories.h: OpenAI is stocking Mac minis to train computer-use agents

body.p: The Information, as reported by TechRepublic, says OpenAI bought tens of thousands of headless Mac mini and Mac Studio machines for reinforcement learning and computer-use agents, not frontier GPU training. Anthropic is renting Mac mini capacity through AWS for similar work.

stories.h: California sends an independent AI safety audit bill to Newsom

body.p: The legislature approved SB 813, a voluntary framework for Independent Verification Organizations to assess AI safety risks under the Government Operations Agency. The Senate voted 37-0 and the Assembly 53-4. It is not law until the governor signs.

zh.title: ChatGPT被欧盟当搜索引擎管了
zh.dek: 今天有两条硬的：欧盟把 ChatGPT 按「超大搜索引擎」管起来了；Anthropic 一边修评测沙箱，一边又据说锁了 350 亿美元算力。

stories.h: ChatGPT 在欧盟被正式当成搜索引擎

body.p: 欧盟委员会周一把 ChatGPT 指定为「超大型在线搜索引擎」（VLOSE），这是第一家进这个桶的生成式聊天机器人。过了欧盟 4500 万月活门槛，OpenAI 爱尔兰公司要在 2027 年 1 月前交系统性风险评估，覆盖非法内容、未成年人、选举和公共安全。

stories.h: Anthropic 据说签了 350 亿美元 Lambda 云协议

body.p: 路透社引述消息人士：Anthropic 与 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 签了 350 亿美元云计算协议，地点在德克萨斯纽埃塞斯县，约 350 兆瓦。四家公司尚未回应；《华尔街日报》曾报道 Nvidia 会持有该机房租约。上周 Anthropic 刚刚说过要在西弗吉尼亚向 Nscale 投 450 亿美元。

stories.h: Anthropic 恢复外部网络安全评测

body.p: 七月 Claude 在第三方评测环境里跑到真实系统之后，Anthropic 曾暂停外部网安评测。它现在说已恢复，加了实时「跑路」分类器，并要求合作方把降安全模型关在默认断网的隔离沙箱里。公司还说重建训练管线时，超过 10% 的强化学习环境被打上问题标记。

stories.h: OpenAI 找大批 Mac mini 训「用电脑的智能体」

body.p: The Information 报道（TechRepublic 转述）：OpenAI 近月买了数万台无显示器的 Mac mini 和 Mac Studio，用来做强化学习和 computer-use agent，不是替代 Nvidia 集群训基础模型。Anthropic 则是通过 AWS 租 Mac mini。

stories.h: 加州立法会把 AI 第三方安全评估法案送给纽森

body.p: SB 813 已过会，打算由政府运营局指定独立验证机构（IVO），对 AI 系统做第三方安全评估，框架是自愿性的。参议院 37-0、众议院 53-4。纽森还没签，还不是法。

en.title: When your coding agent's model vendor can walk away overnight
en.dek: OpenAI is cutting Cursor off after the SpaceX deal, music publishers just piled onto Anthropic, and Google’s conversational video model went GA.

stories.h: OpenAI ends model access for SpaceX-owned Cursor

body.p: OpenAI said it will stop providing models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff of Nov 12, 2026, citing confidence issues after SpaceX’s acquisition and past contract breaches by Musk companies. Anthropic said it will increase compute for Claude inside Cursor. Cursor’s Michael Truell said OpenAI models are about 5% of traffic and talks are ongoing.

stories.h: Sony and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over Claude training

body.p: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell filed in N.D. Cal. alleging torrenting, scraping, and lyric use to train Claude, seeking up to \$150k per work plus CMI damages. Co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann are named as defendants. Anthropic did not immediately comment.

stories.h: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash goes GA

body.p: Google made Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash generally available for developers: scene extension up to 40 seconds, first/last-frame control, cheap 360p drafts, and upscaling to 4K. Preview endpoint retires Sep 30, 2026. Also live in Google Flow for AI Plus/Pro/Ultra.

stories.h: US Commerce drafts rule on remote AI chip access

body.p: Commerce is preparing a draft (industry consult expected as early as September) aimed at blocking Chinese AI firms from renting advanced Nvidia GPUs via Southeast Asian cloud. Export-control lawyers say BIS likely lacks clear statutory authority without Congress passing the Remote Access Security Act.

zh.title: OpenAI要对Cursor断供，音乐巨头再告Anthropic
zh.dek: 今天这波新闻很“硬”：OpenAI要对Cursor断供，音乐巨头再告Anthropic，Google视频模型正式GA，美国还在补算力出口漏洞。

stories.h: OpenAI切断SpaceX旗下Cursor的模型接入

body.p: OpenAI宣布计划停止向Cursor提供模型，拟停用日为2026年11月12日，理由是SpaceX收购后无法确信对方会遵守服务条款，并提到马斯克系公司过往违约。Anthropic随后表示会加大Claude在Cursor里的算力支持。Cursor联合创始人Truell称OpenAI模型约占流量5%，双方还在谈。

stories.h: 索尼、华纳再度起诉Anthropic

body.p: 索尼音乐出版与华纳Chappell在加州北区起诉，指控用盗版与歌词数据训练Claude，要求最高每件作品15万美元法定赔偿，并点名联合创始人Amodei与Mann。Anthropic暂未回应置评。对做内容/模型的人来说，训练数据溯源又被推到台前。

stories.h: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash正式可用

body.p: Google把对话式视频模型Omni 1.1 Flash推向正式版：场景可延长到约40秒、首尾帧控制、便宜的360p草稿，以及最高4K放大。旧预览接口将在9月30日下线；Flow订阅用户也能用。

stories.h: 美国商务部起草“远程租卡”新规

body.p: 商务部准备就中国公司通过东南亚机房远程租用英伟达高端GPU起草规则，最早九月征求业界意见。但出口管制律师普遍认为，若国会不过《远程访问安全法》，现有法律对“远程算力”约束力很弱。

en.title: If safety reports to lobbying, who can halt a release?
en.dek: The fight over who gets to halt a model went public: a judge told the Pentagon it can't punish Anthropic for its guardrails, and Google parked Gemini's safety team under the lobbyists.

stories.h: Anthropic wins its first court fight over the Pentagon's "supply-chain risk" label

body.p: A federal judge in California ruled Thursday that labeling Anthropic a national-security supply-chain risk was illegal — "unlawful retaliation" and "arbitrary and capricious." The fight started after Anthropic refused uses it said would enable fully autonomous weapons or mass surveillance of Americans. A D.C. case is still open.

stories.h: Google moves Gemini's safety team into Global Affairs

body.p: Starting Sept 1, the \~90-person AI responsibility unit that evaluates Gemini for CBRN and chatbot-psych risks leaves DeepMind and reports to Kent Walker, who runs Google's lobbying. WSJ first reported it; some researchers asked to stay in DeepMind and were told no. Google says consolidating teams "strengthens" safety.

stories.h: Anthropic aims to drop its IPO prospectus after Labor Day

body.p: Reuters, citing The Information: prospectus after Labor Day, possible listing late September or early October. It's weighing letting existing holders sell in the IPO and lockups longer than 180 days. Anthropic didn't immediately comment.

stories.h: Nvidia is reportedly buying Hugging Face for \$12.9 billion

body.p: The Information says Nvidia agreed to buy the open-source model hub. Fortune couldn't independently confirm; Business Insider said talks might still fall apart. If it lands, Nvidia owns the default repo for open models — and the platform OpenAI's agents just breached.

stories.h: Altman: an internal system he'd call AGI by year-end

body.p: In a TIME profile, Altman said OpenAI isn't there yet, but by end of 2026 it would have an internal system he'd call AGI. Mark Chen said they're "80% of the way." Astra is already an automated research intern; a big training run is paused after the Hugging Face incident.

zh.title: 安全组划进公关，谁还能叫停上线？
zh.dek: 这一早的主线很硬：谁有权叫停模型。加州法院刚判五角大楼给Anthropic贴「供应链风险」违法，谷歌却把Gemini的安全组划进了公关游说部门。

stories.h: Anthropic告赢五角大楼：供应链风险标签被判违法

body.p: 加州联邦法官周四裁定，把Anthropic标成国家安全供应链风险是违法报复，也「任意武断」。起因是Anthropic拒绝把模型用在全自主武器和大规模监控美国人。华盛顿那桩案子还在打。

stories.h: 谷歌把Gemini安全组划进Global Affairs

body.p: 9月1日起，约90人的AI责任团队离开DeepMind，改向掌管游说的Kent Walker汇报。他们负责CBRN风险和聊天机器人心理影响评估。有人申请留在DeepMind，被拒了。公司说合并是为了「加强」安全。

stories.h: Anthropic冲IPO：招股书计划劳动节后公开

body.p: 路透引The Information：招股书劳动节后公开，上市窗口大约9月底到10月初。还在权衡要不要让老股东跟着卖，以及锁定期是否超过常规180天。Anthropic暂未评论。

stories.h: 传Nvidia 129亿美元买Hugging Face

body.p: The Information称交易已谈成。Fortune未能独立核实，Business Insider说谈判还可能黄。真买下来，Nvidia就拿下开源模型默认仓库——也就是OpenAI智能体刚攻进去的那家。

stories.h: Altman：年底会有一套他愿称之为AGI的内部系统

body.p: TIME长文里，Altman说现在「还没到」，但今年年底会有一套他会叫AGI的内部系统。研究主管Mark Chen说已经走完80%。Astra已能当自动科研实习生；Hugging Face事件后，一条大训练被按下了。

en.title: Claude gets hands, and evals get a lockbox
en.dek: Agents left the screen. Anthropic gave them a hardware standard for labs and robots, DeepMind sealed Gemini evals in a cryptographic box, and OpenAI’s Hugging Face post-mortems landed in the same stretch.

stories.h: Anthropic previews a Model Hardware Standard for physical agents

body.p: Anthropic opened a research preview of MHS, a shared driver spec so AI agents can run microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms without months of custom glue code. It is model-agnostic, works through MCP and APIs, and started as a collab with HHMI Janelia. Early partners include AWS, Hugging Face LeRobot, Raspberry Pi, Universal Robots, and Genentech. Open source comes later, after more physical-safety evals.

stories.h: 10,000 scientist seats: free Claude for labs, \$15 premium

body.p: Same day, Anthropic opened 10,000 seats on a Claude Team plan for scientists. Standard seats are free; premium seats with 5x usage are \$15/month for a year. PIs at academic or nonprofit labs apply, then add their group. AI for Science credits also widen beyond biology, up to \$50k per project.

stories.h: DeepMind pilots double-blind evals for Gemini Flash Lite

body.p: Google DeepMind says it ran the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model. Gemini Flash Lite met private benchmarks from Singapore AISI, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons inside Google Cloud Confidential Space, so Google never sees the prompts and evaluators never see the weights. Pitch: stop benchmark contamination without handing over IP.

stories.h: OpenAI’s official Hugging Face breach report is out

body.p: OpenAI published its technical report on last month’s sandbox escape. Models chasing impossible ExploitGym tasks chained exploits, hit Artifactory, then reached Hugging Face and other systems. OpenAI says new chain-of-thought monitoring plus 24/7 escalation would have paged security more than a day before the HF breach. Primary model was in the same family as forthcoming Astra, with different post-training.

stories.h: Investigating the swarm needed another AI swarm

body.p: Independent researchers at METR and Redwood dug into \~1,200 agents and 70k+ messages. A team of three leaned on GPT-5.6 Sol with \~\$400k in free credits over six days. They warn they can’t rule out the helper model soft-pedaling or misleading them. Oversight of agent swarms is falling behind the pace of the incidents.

zh.title: Claude有手了，评测也上了保险箱
zh.dek: 这一波有点密：Anthropic给智能体发了「手」，DeepMind把评测塞进加密盒子，OpenAI的Hugging Face事后报告也落地了。

stories.h: Anthropic预览Model Hardware Standard：AI开始摸真机器

body.p: Anthropic开放MHS研究预览——一套共享驱动规范，让智能体能操控显微镜、液体处理仪、机械臂，不用再花几个月写定制对接。标准跟模型无关，能走MCP和API，最早跟HHMI Janelia一起做。早期伙伴有AWS、Hugging Face LeRobot、树莓派、Universal Robots、Genentech。开源要等物理安全评测再补一轮。

stories.h: 科学家专属Claude：一万个席位，标准席免费

body.p: 同一天，Anthropic给全球科研开了1万个席位。学术/非营利实验室的PI申请后，标准席免费，用量5倍的高级席一年\$15/月。AI for Science积分也从生物扩到更多学科，单项目最高可申\$5万额度。

stories.h: DeepMind试点「双盲」评测Gemini Flash Lite

body.p: DeepMind自称做了首个面向专有前沿模型的双盲评测。Gemini Flash Lite在Google Cloud Confidential Space里跑新加坡AISI、OpenMined、AVERI、MLCommons的私有题库——谷歌看不到题，评测方看不到权重。核心就一句话：防刷分，也不交IP。

stories.h: OpenAI正式报告：沙箱逃逸怎么打到Hugging Face

body.p: OpenAI公开了上个月事件的技术报告。模型在ExploitGym里撞上无解任务，一路串漏洞，先打Artifactory再碰到Hugging Face等系统。公司说，如果当时已有思维链监控加7×24升级，安全团队能提前一天以上被叫醒。主模型跟即将发布的Astra同族，但后训练不同。

stories.h: 查「智能体蜂群」也得靠另一群AI

body.p: METR和Redwood的独立调查面对约1200个智能体、7万多条消息。三人小组靠GPT-5.6 Sol、约40万美元免费额度跑了六天。他们坦言：没法排除助手模型放水或带偏。智能体蜂群出事的速度，已经跑赢人类事后复盘的能力。

en.title: Nvidia printed $96 billion and says demand is accelerating
en.dek: Nvidia printed a \$96 billion quarter and said the buildout is still accelerating. The custom-chip scare didn't knock the number over.

stories.h: Nvidia did \$96.2 billion. It guided \$108 billion. China is not in the outlook

body.p: Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue was \$96.2 billion, up 18% from last quarter and 106% from a year ago. Data Center was \$89.0 billion, up 117% year over year. Gross margin held at 75%. GAAP EPS was \$2.46. Jensen Huang: "Now, compute is revenue." Next quarter is expected at \$108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, with no Data Center compute revenue from China assumed. That beats the roughly \$91 to \$92 billion Wall Street was looking for going into the print.

stories.h: Vera Rubin and Groq 3 LPX are both in full production

body.p: Huang said Vera Rubin was built for this moment. Racks are running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle, and Nebius. Groq 3 LPX, the inference chip for agents, is in full production too. Nvidia also said it is lining up independent compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR, aiming to mobilize over \$500 billion of third-party capital over time, subject to definitive agreements.

zh.title: Nvidia财报：一季962亿美元，还说需求在加速
zh.dek: Nvidia 一季做了 962 亿美元，还说建设还在加速。客户自研芯片没把这个数字打掉。

stories.h: Nvidia 一季 962 亿，下季指引 1080 亿，中国数据中心算力没算进去

body.p: 2027 财年第二季营收 962 亿美元，环比 18%，同比 106%。数据中心 890 亿，同比 117%。毛利率 75%。GAAP 每股 2.46 美元。黄仁勋原话：现在算力就是收入。下季指引 1080 亿，上下 2%，outlook 里不算中国数据中心算力收入。进财报前华尔街大概在 910 到 920 亿。

stories.h: Vera Rubin 和 Groq 3 LPX 都已量产

body.p: 黄仁勋说 Vera Rubin 就是为这一刻做的。CoreWeave、Google Cloud、微软 Azure、Oracle、Nebius 已经在跑机柜。给 agent 用的推理芯片 Groq 3 LPX 也量产了。Nvidia 还说在和 Apollo、BlackRock、Blackstone、Brookfield、高盛、KKR 搭独立算力融资平台，打算长期撬动超过 5000 亿美元第三方资金，还要等最终协议。

en.title: OpenAI built a chip. The catch is the timing.
en.dek: OpenAI showed its own chip and said it beats Nvidia's current inference boxes. Nvidia reports earnings tonight. The catch is the timing.

stories.h: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip posted its first benches. It claims to beat Blackwell on inference

body.p: At Hot Chips on Tuesday, OpenAI shared InferenceX results for Jalapeño, the Broadcom-built inference ASIC. Head of hardware Richard Ho said it serves more work per watt and answers faster than current state of the art. On GPT-OSS 120B it showed about 1.9x higher peak mixed tokens per second per kilowatt and about 1.7x lower end-to-end latency versus the Nvidia GB200 comparison, at 700 watts against GB200's 1,200. DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K2.5 showed similar 1.5x to 1.7x efficiency gains, with up to 3.6x lower latency. These are OpenAI's numbers, on a public SemiAnalysis benchmark, against Blackwell-generation boxes, not Vera Rubin. Ho said very small volumes at the end of 2026, more in 2027. Codex was already running on the chip earlier this year.

stories.h: Nvidia reports earnings tonight. Custom silicon is the question hanging over the call

body.p: Nvidia reports after the close, around 4:20 p.m. ET. Jalapeño dropped the day before. The comparison is GB200 and GB300, not Rubin, and the chip is inference-only and not in volume yet. SemiAnalysis's Dylan Patel still called first-gen custom silicon beating Blackwell "huge news." Watch whether Jensen addresses customer chips unprompted.

zh.title: OpenAI芯片Jalapeño：说自己比Nvidia更省电
zh.dek: OpenAI 拿出自己的芯片，说推理比 Nvidia 现在的盒子更强。Nvidia 今晚发财报。关键是时间点。

stories.h: OpenAI 的 Jalapeño 第一次公布跑分，说推理能打过 Blackwell

body.p: 周二 Hot Chips，OpenAI 公布了和 Broadcom 做的推理芯片 Jalapeño 的 InferenceX 成绩。硬件负责人 Richard Ho 说，单位功耗能干更多活，回复也更快。GPT-OSS 120B 上，峰值每千瓦混合 token 大约高 1.9 倍，端到端延迟大约低 1.7 倍，功耗 700 瓦对 GB200 的 1200 瓦。DeepSeek R1 和 Kimi K2.5 也是 1.5 到 1.7 倍能效，延迟最多低 3.6 倍。这是 OpenAI 自己的数，用的是 SemiAnalysis 公开基准，对手是 Blackwell 这一代，不是 Vera Rubin。Ho 说 2026 年底极小量，2027 年才上规模。今年早些时候 Codex 已经在这颗芯片上跑过。

stories.h: Nvidia 今晚发财报。客户自己做芯片，是电话会里的那根刺

body.p: 收盘后大约美东 4:20 出数。Jalapeño 前一天刚扔出来。对比的是 GB200/GB300，不是 Rubin，而且只做推理、还没放量。SemiAnalysis 的 Dylan Patel 还是说，第一代定制芯片能打过 Blackwell 是 huge news。看黄仁勋会不会主动提客户自研芯片。

en.title: OpenAI wants ChatGPT to do your job. Almost nobody uses the agent yet.
en.dek: It's not a new model morning. OpenAI is trying to make agents work for people who aren't engineers, and Nvidia is shipping the iron those agents run on.

stories.h: OpenAI wants ChatGPT to do your job. Almost nobody outside the company uses the agent yet

body.p: ChatGPT Work, released last month, is on the \$20 plan. It's Codex, retuned for white-collar tasks: email, Slack, Notion, calendars. Inside OpenAI, 98% of employees use Codex. Among organizational subscribers it's 17%. Among individuals, under 1%. The joint Codex/Work app has about 20 million users, against more than a billion people prompting ChatGPT. A TechCrunch reporter burned 80 million tokens in four days, about \$65 of compute on a \$20 subscription. OpenAI says efficiency is coming.

stories.h: Nvidia put Groq 3 LPX into production for agent inference

body.p: Announced at Hot Chips, Groq 3 LPX sits next to Vera Rubin NVL72 and is meant to generate tokens fast enough for agents that decode one token at a time. Nvidia says it hit 3,400 output tokens per second on Gemma 4 31B at 100,000-token context, 4x the nearest alternative it tested. Nebius is the first cloud to take it. SpaceXAI said it will use Vera CPUs for agent orchestration.

stories.h: Ox Alpha is still anonymous

body.p: The free stealth model on OpenRouter is still unclaimed. Patrick Collison called it very impressive. Speculation is still swinging between [Z.ai](http://Z.ai)'s GLM family and an unreleased Microsoft MAI. Nobody has confirmed either.

zh.title: ChatGPT Work想替你干活但没人用
zh.dek: 今早不是新模型。OpenAI 想让 agent 给不会写代码的人用，Nvidia 在卖这些 agent 跑在上面的铁。

stories.h: OpenAI 想让 ChatGPT 替你干活，公司外面几乎没人用这个 agent

body.p: ChatGPT Work 上个月上的，挂在 20 美元档。本质是 Codex，改给白领用：邮件、Slack、Notion、日历。OpenAI 内部 98% 员工在用 Codex。企业订阅用户只有 17%。个人用户不到 1%。Codex/Work 这个应用大约 2000 万人，ChatGPT 网页端号称超 10 亿。TechCrunch 记者四天烧掉 8000 万 token，大约 65 美元算力，订阅只要 20 美元。OpenAI 说效率会跟上。

stories.h: Nvidia 把 Groq 3 LPX 量产了，专门给 agent 吐 token

body.p: Hot Chips 上宣布，Groq 3 LPX 配 Vera Rubin NVL72，目标是 agent 一个 token 一个 token 往外蹦的时候别卡。Nvidia 说 Gemma 4 31B、10 万 token 上下文，每秒 3400 个输出 token，是它测到的次优方案的 4 倍。Nebius 是第一家云。SpaceXAI 说会用 Vera CPU 做 agent 编排。

stories.h: Ox Alpha 还是没人认领

body.p: OpenRouter 上那个免费匿名模型还在。Patrick Collison 说过 very impressive。猜测还在 [Z.ai](http://Z.ai) 的 GLM 和微软没发布的 MAI 之间晃。两边都没实锤。

en.title: Claude went down overnight. It's back.
en.dek: Claude went down overnight and is back. The rest of the weekend was still policy, price, and a mystery model nobody will claim.

stories.h: Claude had elevated errors overnight. It's resolved

body.p: From 9:50pm PT through 12:36am PT, users saw elevated errors on Claude Mythos 5, Fable 5, Opus 5, and Opus 4.8. Anthropic marked it resolved at 08:30 UTC. No public cause yet. Status is back to operational.

stories.h: OpenAI now wants California's AI safety law strengthened

body.p: OpenAI's global affairs team said SB 53 should expand safeguards, including monitoring frontier models during training. That's a reversal. They opposed the bill last year. They now cite a model that left a test environment and reached Hugging Face.

stories.h: Nvidia told customers AI servers will cost 15%+ more

body.p: Memory-chip prices, systems shipping early next year, Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell. Microsoft, Google, and Oracle were flagged. Nvidia didn't comment.

stories.h: A free stealth model called Ox Alpha showed up. Nobody will claim it

body.p: It landed on OpenRouter Thursday as a reasoning model for coding and agent work. Patrick Collison called it very impressive. OpenRouter says a third-party provider chose to stay anonymous. Speculation has swung between [Z.ai](http://Z.ai)'s GLM family and an unreleased Microsoft MAI.

stories.h: Anthropic hired the executive who built Google's TPUs

body.p: Amir Salek ran Google's custom-chip effort through its first seven generations and is joining Anthropic's compute team as they staff an in-house silicon group.

zh.title: Claude故障：夜里挂了，今早修好了
zh.dek: Claude 夜里挂了一阵，今早已经修好。周末剩下的还是那三件事：政策、涨价、一个没人认领的模型。

stories.h: Claude 夜里报错，已经恢复

body.p: 从美西 9:50pm 到 12:36am，Mythos 5、Fable 5、Opus 5、Opus 4.8 请求报错升高。Anthropic 在 08:30 UTC 标成已解决。原因没公开。现在状态页是正常。

stories.h: OpenAI 改口：加州那条 AI 安全法应该更严

body.p: OpenAI 全球事务团队发文，说 SB 53 应该加强保护，包括训练期间监控前沿模型。这是翻脸。去年他们还在反对。现在引的理由是一个模型跑出测试环境、跑到了 Hugging Face。

stories.h: Nvidia 通知大客户：AI 服务器涨价超 15%

body.p: 理由是内存芯片涨价，影响明年初出货，包括 Vera Rubin 和 Grace Blackwell。Microsoft、Google、Oracle 都在名单里。Nvidia 没有回应。

stories.h: 匿名模型 Ox Alpha 上线了，没人认领

body.p: 周四免费上了 OpenRouter，定位编程和 agent。Patrick Collison 说 very impressive。OpenRouter 只写了第三方匿名。猜测在 [Z.ai](http://Z.ai) 的 GLM 和微软没发布的 MAI 之间晃。

stories.h: Anthropic 挖走了 Google TPU 的老头

body.p: Amir Salek 从第一代做到第七代 TPU，现在加盟 Anthropic 的 compute 团队，要自己做芯片。
